references.title: A series of wide-host-range low-copy-number vectors that allow direct screening for recombinants.

provenance.sequence_source: M37846 (cloning vector pMMB190; Morales et al. 1991) 8585..8662, reverse strand, identical over 78 bp; the oldest of 404 exact deposits. It is PlacI (J01636 1..78) with the lacIq 'up' mutation at J01636 base 16 (c in wild type, t in I-Q), recorded as a variation in J01636 after Calos 1978.
